disposition: CoF generative denoising feasibility blocker; only a census sentence names the candidate. The upstream source, exact checkpoints, generative runtime, rights and inputs are absent, so there is no implementation, execution or result.

requirement_rows.evidence: The synthetic envelope copies caller bytes exactly and labels an identity control, but no CoF candidate, noise injection or established enhancement baseline is executed.
requirement_rows.requirement: Identity/noisy control plus an established task-matched baseline.

requirement_rows.evidence: No rights-cleared clean-reference cohort, independent scorer or candidate output exists; no paired metric is computed.
requirement_rows.requirement: Paired SI-SDR and STOI where permitted clean references exist.

requirement_rows.evidence: Only synthetic finite/peak breath checks on copied bytes exist; no clean-speech preservation result and no candidate output validity result is available.
requirement_rows.requirement: Clean-speech preservation, peaks and invalid outputs.

requirement_rows.evidence: The exact generative runtime, sampler, padding recipe and device are absent; no alignment, state, memory or availability timing was measured.
requirement_rows.requirement: Alignment, state, memory and measured content/availability timing for the exact runtime.

requirement_rows.evidence: No unpaired speech, predictive screen or listening protocol and result exists.
requirement_rows.requirement: Separately labeled predictive screen or authorized listening for unpaired speech.

requirement_rows.evidence: No real or synthetic speech condition is scored; the envelope uses one deterministic placeholder frame that is not audio evidence.
requirement_rows.requirement: Quiet and active speech, idle noise, low SNR and onset/offset condition coverage.

requirement_rows.evidence: The report keeps synthetic envelope, admission schema, historical census prose and missing real results in distinct sections; no category is pooled with another.
requirement_rows.requirement: Separate paired, unpaired, synthetic, human and source-reported evidence.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact upstream repository URL and immutable revision for both formulations, the complete source snapshot, the code license and notice text, and a formulation-to-file map. No download is permitted inside this package.
exact_blockers.statement: No upstream source identity is recorded. The pinned census names 'CoF denoising checkpoints' and an 'Official 2026 repository' but gives no repository URL, commit, release tag, source file, code license or notice. No CoF source is present at any probed path.

exact_blockers.required_action: Stage the complete checkpoint set for both corpora, both formulations and both stages with exact file names, immutable revision, byte counts and matching SHA-256 values, plus an artifact-specific terms review. No weight may be downloaded, reconstructed or inferred here.
exact_blockers.statement: No checkpoint identity or byte set is recorded. The census says VoiceBank+Demand and WSJ0+WHAM checkpoints exist for two formulations and both pretrained and corrective-forcing stages, but records no file names, immutable revision, byte counts or SHA-256 values. No checkpoint file is present at any probed path.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide a locked offline Python/PyTorch-class runtime with wheel names, versions, byte counts, SHA-256 values and install location, plus the exact sampler, steps, seed, dtype, device, context and padding recipe used for the reference.
exact_blockers.statement: No generative runtime is installed or pinned. The probed interpreters expose no torch or torchaudio, no CoF environment or wheel lock exists, and no sampler, step count, seed, dtype, device, context or padding recipe is recorded.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide a digest-pinned, rights-reviewed caller-owned input set with corpus, acquisition, evaluation, derived-output and redistribution decisions, the checkpoint training-data terms for both corpora, and an attribution record.
exact_blockers.statement: No rights-cleared caller input set or training-data review exists. The census says to verify weight/code/data terms but records no license, training corpus terms, derived-output permission or redistribution decision for either corpus.

exact_blockers.required_action: After the source, checkpoint, runtime and rights gates clear, run both corpora and both stages offline with deterministic settings and no network; record per-item hashes, finite and length-preserving checks, exact repeats, identity/noisy controls, paired SI-SDR/STOI, preservation, peaks, alignment, state, memory and timing.
exact_blockers.statement: No CoF inference or enhancement result is reproduced. Without source, checkpoint bytes, runtime and inputs, there is no identity/noisy control, candidate output, paired SI-SDR/STOI, clean-speech preservation, finite/length check, alignment, state, memory or content/availability timing.

exact_blockers.required_action: Measure mode and platform separately, record device timing and resources, run authorized listening or a labeled predictive screen, then open a separate versioned OFF-by-default provider intake with clean-install proof and independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, descriptor, registry entry, default selection, mode/platform measurement, listening test, benchmark result or release claim exists. The package is task-local evidence only.

rows.evidence: The census describes an offline generative family but records no runtime, sampler, hardware or whole-clip measurement; nothing was run.
No streaming CoF formulation, checkpoint or runtime is recorded; no streaming result is claimed.
No phone, GPU, NPU, callback, thermal, battery, energy or target-device measurement exists.

non_claims: No CoF source, repository, checkpoint, weight, config or sampler implementation is present, loaded, deserialized or reconstructed.
No torch, torchaudio, generative runtime or model dependency is imported, installed, linked or executed.
No real audio, corpus, manifest payload or model output is read or produced.
No CoF inference, quality, fidelity, parity, speed, resource, listening, device or benchmark result is reproduced or claimed.
The synthetic envelope and admission control are protocol plumbing only; they are not a model, a sampler, a checkpoint, a quality result or a qualification.
No provider, descriptor, registry, default, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
The census sentence is source-reported context only and is not promoted to measured evidence.
reopening_conditions: Pin the exact upstream source revision, license and notice for both formulations.
Stage both corpora and both stages with per-file byte counts and SHA-256 values.
Provide a locked offline runtime and the exact sampler configuration.
Provide rights-cleared inputs and checkpoint training-data terms.
Reproduce deterministic offline runs and complete the Enhancement profile, including controls and preservation.
Measure mode and platform separately, complete listening or a labeled predictive screen, then open a separate OFF-by-default intake and independent review.

required_artifacts.requirement: The pinned candidate census, structured inventory record, acceptance profile, SDK delivery plan and unchanged v0 contract boundary.
The exact upstream repository URL, immutable commit or release revision, source tree for both formulations, code license, notice and model-card/README text.

The complete checkpoint set for VoiceBank+DEMAND and WSJ0+WHAM covering the two reported formulations and both the pretrained and corrective-forcing stages, with exact file names, immutable revision, byte counts and SHA-256 values.

A locked offline Python/PyTorch-class runtime with wheel names, versions, byte counts, SHA-256 values and install location, plus the exact sampler, step count, seed, dtype, device, context and padding recipe.

A digest-pinned caller-owned input set with corpus, acquisition, evaluation, derived-output and redistribution decisions, plus checkpoint training-data terms for both corpora and an attribution record.

A deterministic offline run in the exact runtime with per-item input/output hashes, finite and length-preserving checks, exact repeats, peak/RSS values, identity/noisy controls, paired SI-SDR/STOI, preservation, alignment, state, memory and content/availability timing.

A separate versioned OFF-by-default developer tool or provider intake with clean-install proof, empty defaults, no registry or shared-build change, separate mode/platform measurements and independent exact-head review after every other gate clears.

required_results: Exact upstream URL, immutable revision, source snapshot, license and notice for both formulations.
Complete checkpoint manifest for both corpora, both formulations and both stages with byte counts and SHA-256.
Locked offline runtime with wheel digests, install location and clean-room import digest.
Exact sampler, steps, seed, dtype, device, context and padding recipe.
Rights-cleared, digest-pinned caller inputs and checkpoint training-data terms.
Deterministic reproduced runs with finite/length-preserving outputs and exact repeats.
Identity/noisy controls, task-matched baseline, paired SI-SDR/STOI and clean-speech preservation.
Alignment, state, memory and content/availability timing for the exact runtime.
Separate mode/platform timing, authorized listening and independent provider intake review.

reopen_conditions: Pin wheel names, versions, byte counts and SHA-256 values for the exact CoF generative runtime.
Record the isolated install location and a clean-room import digest.
Record the exact sampler, steps, seed, dtype, device, context and padding recipe.
Load the staged checkpoints offline with networking disabled before any claim.
